generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidders shall strictly upload only the documents required under the tender conditions. No additional, irrelevant or unsolicited documents shall be uploaded.

technicalCriterionList.description: Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid Electrical License for executing building electrificatio works and should have executed similar electrical works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid license for executing water supply / sanitary engineering works  and should have executed similar works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year
Owning the following key and critical equipment for this work (xxxx, xxxx, xxxx)
Liquid assets and /or availability of credit facilities of no less than Rs. xxxxxx Lakhs (estimated cash flow for 3 months of peak construction period)
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing works
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditor’s reports for the last five years

Satisfactorily completed, as a prime contractor, at least one similar work of value not less than Rs. 137.50 lakh (Rupees One Crore Thirty Seven Lakh Fifty Thousand only.Similar works shall mean construction of community toilets, public toilet complexes, sanitary blocks, public buildings, institutional buildings or comparable building works involving civil construction and associated water supply, plumbing and sanitary installations.
Valid KPWD Class-I (Civil) Contractor License Registration

Achieved, in at least two financial years, a minimum annual financial turnover of Rs. 550.00 lakh (Rupees Five Crore Fifty Lakh only) in civil engineering construction works. The tenderer shall submit a year-wise financial turnover certificate duly certified by a practising Chartered Accountant, bearing the CAs signature, seal, membership number and valid Unique Document Identification Number (UDIN), along with supporting audited financial statements.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

technicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer shall demonstrate availability of liquid assets and/or credit facilities of not less than Rs. 82.50 lakh (Rupees Sixty-Nine Lakh Ninety-One Thousand only) from nationalised or scheduled banks for meeting the financial requirements of the work. The bankers certificate should be submitted as per the below format only.

Executed during any one year (continuous period of 12 months), the following minimum quantities of work 1.Earthwork excavation in all kinds of soils, including foundation excavation-1075.51 Cum, 2.Concrete work, including PCC and RCC-251.31 Cum, 3. Structural steel work, including tubular trusses and built up steel sections-5.24 MT, 4.TMT reinforcement steel work-17.55 MT, 5.Solid concrete block masonry / equivalent masonry wall work-1462.14 Sqm, 6.Cement plastering work-2961.52 Sqm and 7.Laying of ceramic/glazed tiles, including flooring, skirting and dadoing-2225.56 Sqm

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Valid KPWD Class-I Civil Contractor License Registration
Work Done Certificate with minimum quantities
The tenderer shall possess valid contractor registration of the appropriate class with the prescribed Government Department/Organisation.
The tenderer shall not be under any declaration of ineligibility, blacklisted by any public authorities or debarment by the Government of Karnataka for corrupt or fraudulent practices.
Joint venture tenders shall not be accepted.
The tenderer shall furnish all prescribed qualification documents, declarations, certificates and details required under the applicable Standard Tender Document.
